text: Entry 1207 wraps SyncComponents.manifest packaging in MOZ_SERVICES_SYNC. Entry 1208 removes the same guard, and blob comparison proves that the package manifest returned to its pre-landing content. The backout message reports test failures without identifying the exact cause. The accepted manifest no longer contains this component entry, so this historical chain is not evidence for a current packaging recommendation. Both diffs and the restoration proof were read; no failing test was reproduced and Bugzilla/Phabricator context remains pending. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
